'''Tango Company''' was an elite [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Members of Tango Company bore a striped sigil on their armored shoulder plates that resembled a stylized [[Tiger/Legends|tiger]] face and teal blue markings.

==History==
[[File:TangoCompany-BI.png|thumb|left|200px|Tango Company on board ''TB-73'']]
Shortly after the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], trooper [[Scythe (clone trooper)/Legends|Scythe]] got infected by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]]. Later, on board the medical frigate [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']], he helped spread the infection amongst the clones, who were mind-controlled by the worms and were forced to attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The unit's leader, [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Trap/Legends|Trap]], was killed by [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] in self-defense. However, the infection was eventually dealt with, and most clones of the company survived the incident.

Besides [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Trap and Scythe, members of Tango Company included [[Edge/Legends|Edge]], [[Havoc (clone trooper)/Legends|Havoc]], [[Ox/Legends|Ox]], and [[Pulsar (clone trooper)/Legends|Pulsar]].

It continued to serve in the Galactic Empire, where it and its members were awarded the [[Medal of Valor/Legends|Imperial Medal of Valor]] for its role in the [[Lasan Suppression]].

[[Color/Legends|Green]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]] next to the exit of the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] in the [[79's/Legends|79's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] said "TANGO CO".<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
